authenticity_review: Image demonstrates strong technical execution with sharp focus and vibrant color rendering. However, significant AI artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) Fusion/melting at clasped paws where digits merge into indistinct masses between adjacent bears; (2) Anatomical collapse at feet-water interface lacking defined toes or proper displacement; (3) Uniformly airbrushed red fur texture without natural strand variation or lighting response. These structural defects indicate generative model limitations despite overall clean composition.
